dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 25, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Pirates Pull Off Stunning Upset, Cardinals Fall to Brewers**

The Pittsburgh Pirates stunned the Chicago Cubs with a 2-1 victory, led by Michael Busch's impressive performance - 1 hit, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Ben Brown dominated on the mound, tossing 6 innings with 7 strikeouts and just 1 earned run. Meanwhile, in Milwaukee, Christian Yelich hit a home run and had 2 RBIs to propel the Brewers to a 5-1 win over the St. Louis Cardinals. Jacob Misiorowski was nearly unhittable, striking out 12 in 7 innings.

In other action, the Baltimore Orioles came from behind to defeat the Tampa Bay Rays 9-7, with Colton Cowser hitting a home run and Jonathan Aranda driving in 2 runs. The Chicago White Sox took down the Minnesota Twins 3-1, with Drew Romo going deep and Anthony Kay earning the win with 6 strong innings. The Cincinnati Reds also picked up a win, defeating the New York Mets 7-2 behind Nick Lodolo's 6 shutout innings and Tyler Stephenson's home run.
